effects.network: Leaf temporarily replaces http.DefaultTransport. Proxy callback refuses noninitial/non-HTTPS requests and returns no proxy; plaintext DialContext always errors; DialTLSContext ignores provider hostname and dials literal known loopback listener with fixture TLS trust. Thus OCI SDK regional/home/KMS/storage/compute/IAM/network/observation and pricing URLs go to local simulator without DNS egress. Parent directly sets its ObjectStorage client.Host to its local HTTP server after leaf cleanup.
effects.files: Three t.TempDir roots: leaf XDG_CONFIG_HOME, leaf SHA256-named object files, parent protocol-store files. Leaf production trust-floor code creates XDG_CONFIG_HOME/terrascale-orchestrator/foundation (0700), per-tenancy floor JSON/lock (0600), temporary floor files, flock/fsync/rename. Simulator and parent journal/object files are 0600. SDK RSA private keys remain in memory, not emitted to files by fixture. Temp roots cleaned by testing.
effects.crypto: Two explicit Ed25519 keypairs in leaf; one RSA2048 signing key in leaf and another RSA2048 in parent protocol helper; random IDs/temp floor suffixes; httptest uses standard test TLS certificate. Image/root/production evidence signatures are test generated, not live qualification.
